description: String containing a lone UTF-16 surrogate MUST be rejected before any canonical bytes are emitted (docs/canonicalization.md §7.13). At the verifier level this surfaces as PIC_SCHEMA_INVALID per docs/spec-core.md §9.1; at the canonicalizer level, the reference implementation raises CanonicalizationError. This vector pins the canonicalizer's rejection contract only; the pipeline-level PIC_SCHEMA_INVALID enforcement is covered by a dedicated Python regression test.
source: docs/canonicalization.md §7.13; canonical_reject runner verdict added in v0.9.0a1.
